mechanism.summary: Cache immutable captured-slot classification and a fixed-owned-cell topology proof on bytecode. For eligible direct-eval ordinary frames, keep the first ordered overlay and map identity/generation validation, then skip redundant full local/cell enumeration on memo hits. Private owned cells cannot be realm cells, so initial realm-membership classification may return zero under the same proof and module-routing guard. This opens the declaration packet without changing activation ABI, binding storage or tiers. Path boundary: bytecode/ir.rs, mod.rs, vm_frame_init.rs, vm_bindings.rs, new vm_binding_instantiation.rs/tests, function/env.rs, focused fixtures if needed, task/index/measurement files and env-model-rewrite.md invariant. All brief exclusions and hot-functions.order excluded.
mechanism.generality: Admission is derived from operation effects, local binding kinds, initialized cells and immutable slot/capture metadata, not function/source names, literals, sibling/scope counts, bytecode templates or benchmark identity. Values remain in their canonical slots/shared cells. Dynamic map remaps invalidate by existing generation; unsupported cell topology retains exact old validation.
semantic_risks: Reject lexical clear/fresh iteration, global/sloppy/eval-deletable bindings, received upvalues, with and parameter prologues for fixed topology. Keep module-affine storage on original realm classification.
Arguments aliases and eval/closure mutations must share the original cells; eval-added names and declaration-bearing eval must still revoke scope bypass.
Cache captures only from immutable bytecode classification; eval metadata mutation must not stale topology eligibility.
Keep all new work out of line; no hot executor or call_leaf growth and no linker re-pin.

Controls include all six sentinels plus xparb, tagcloud, unpack-code, ai-astar and broad closure_allocation_call/captured_write. Extra eval-heavy file control repeated_cached_eval_scope will be included in every screen and held to 1.03 cycles/instructions; no plan/schema relaxation.
If a control fails cycles with unchanged instructions, report nm -n address/size for wide, VM, call_leaf and cache probe; classify placement without spending an attempt.

profile_evidence.shared_cost: Exact af4d0d3c sampler: 311/3448 overlay inclusive (9.02%), 75/3448 immutable upvalue resolution (2.18%), disjoint helper groups. Real-case counters: 27000 memo hits of 28000 scoped closures, 1.4m closure local visits, 38000 new frame cells and 45k captured cells. Parent-scope 16/50/100 nonempty declaration increments scale on Rust eval-capable frames while NG stays near 0.75k cycles/closure.
